items.exampleEn: The results were far below our expectations.
items.exampleZh: 結果遠低於我們的預期。

items.exampleEn: Keep this guide for future reference.
items.exampleZh: 把這份指南留著，以後可以參考。

items.exampleEn: The insurance company sent someone to assess the damage.
items.exampleZh: 保險公司派人來評估損失。

items.exampleEn: She listened calmly to the criticism of her plan.
items.exampleZh: 她冷靜地聽取別人對她計畫的批評。

items.exampleEn: Dogs can perceive sounds that people can't hear.
items.exampleZh: 狗能察覺到人類聽不到的聲音。

items.exampleEn: Good planning makes a trip much easier.
items.exampleZh: 好的規劃讓旅行輕鬆許多。

items.exampleEn: There is little prospect of finding a cheap flight now.
items.exampleZh: 現在要找到便宜機票的希望不大。

items.exampleEn: Teachers evaluate students' work in different ways.
items.exampleZh: 老師們用不同的方式評量學生的作業。

items.sentenceEn: The company will evaluate every new worker after three months.
items.sentenceZh: 公司會在三個月後評估每位新員工。

items.audioEn: Thanks to careful planning, the event finished on time and under budget.
items.audioZh: 多虧周詳的規劃，活動準時結束，也沒有超出預算。
items.questionZh: 這場活動為什麼進行得很順利？
options: Because many people came to help
Because it was free for everyone

items.sentenceEn: This new job offers good prospects for promotion.
items.sentenceZh: 這份新工作有很好的升遷前景。

items.sentenceEn: Don't take criticism personally; use it to improve.
items.sentenceZh: 別把批評當成針對你個人，要用它來進步。

items.stemEn: Before you hire someone, it is wise to ask for a ____ from their last employer.
items.stemZh: 聘請某人之前，向他前一份工作的老闆要一封推薦信是明智的做法。

items.stemEn: Many people ____ him as unfriendly, but he is only shy.
items.stemZh: 很多人認為他不友善，但他只是害羞。

items.passageEn: Every December, our company holds a review meeting with each worker. The manager uses a form to assess our work and evaluate our progress toward the year's goals. Some people worry about criticism, but the meetings are usually informal and positive. My manager explained that the review is about planning for the future, not punishing past mistakes. She said I had met her expectations and that my prospects for promotion were good. She also offered to write a reference if I ever wanted to study abroad. Now I perceive these meetings as a chance to grow, not a test.
items.passageZh: 每年十二月，公司都會和每位員工開一次考核面談。經理用一張表格評估我們的工作，並評量我們在年度目標上的進展。有些人擔心被批評，但面談通常都很輕鬆、正面。我的經理解釋說，考核是為了規劃未來，不是懲罰過去的錯誤。她說我達到了她的期待，升遷的前景也很好。她還說，如果我哪天想出國念書，她願意幫我寫推薦信。現在我把這些面談看作成長的機會，而不是一場考試。

questions.questionZh: 經理說考核面談的目的是什麼？
經理表示願意為作者做什麼？

items.promptZh: 我們需要評估這個計畫的成本。
referenceEn: We need to evaluate the cost of this plan.
We have to evaluate the costs of the plan.
rubricZh: evaluate 後面直接接要評估的事（例如 evaluate the cost）
寫 assess 意思也對；「需要」可寫 need to、have to 等

items.instructionZh: 用 expectation 造一個句子，說說某件事比你預期的好或差。
referenceEn: My first job did not meet my expectations.
The service at the hotel went beyond my expectations.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 expectation，常用複數（例如 meet my expectations、beyond my expectations）
句子要說到你自己的經驗
